Total carbons: aromatic 6 + two methoxy carbons (2) + allyl chain carbons (3) = 11. Good.

But fragments list 'CO' twice, which could be -CO (carbonyl) but no carbonyl. 'CO' could be -CH2-O-? Actually 'CO' as SMILES fragment is carbon attached to oxygen (C-O). Could be -CH2-O- (hydroxymethyl). But we have two 'CO' fragments, maybe they are -CH2-O- groups (hydroxymethyl). But we have O3 total, no carbonyl. Could be phenoxy groups: -O-CH3 (methoxy) each is CO. So that's fine.
